Alley Net Spread.name: Alley Net Spread
Alley Net Spread.description: The user crosses several tape strips between the walls of an alley or hallway, making a visible net. Up to three advancing human-sized opponents are caught and held until they cut or tear free; held back, the net cushions a collision. It needs firm anchors on both sides, and fire or blades can open a route through it. Strain: heavy.
